title: Iceberg Maintenance
description: Runs Iceberg table maintenance on each declared output table: compact small files, rewrite manifests, expire snapshots and delete orphan files, in that order.

dry_run.description: Plan only: report what each enabled task would do and change nothing.

compact.description: Bin-packs the small data files of each table into target-size files in one atomic snapshot.

target_file_size_mb.description: Target size of a compacted Parquet file in MiB.
target_file_size_mb.x-datuplet-doc: Files smaller than 75% of this are compaction candidates; files larger than 180% are never rewritten. Defaults to the pipeline's gateway.targetFileSize.

min_input_files.description: Minimum number of small files in one partition before it is worth rewriting.

max_input_files.description: Upper bound on input files rewritten in one run; the rest is left for a later run.

rewrite_manifests.description: Rewrites many small manifest files into fewer larger ones to speed up query planning.

target_manifest_size_mb.description: Target size of a rewritten manifest file in MiB.

expire_snapshots.description: Removes old snapshots and the data files only they reference.

older_than_hours.description: Expire snapshots older than this many hours (minimum 24).

retain_last.description: Always keep at least this many of the most recent snapshots.

delete_orphan_files.description: Deletes storage files under the table location that no snapshot references.

older_than_hours.description: Only delete orphan files older than this many hours (minimum 25).

max_files.description: Upper bound on files deleted in one run.
